SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. Misc. 4/34 / C.P. & B. REGT. / Yangtzepoo Station, / D.H.S.H/H / Date 27th 1 2 1934）

REPORT

Subject (in full) Further report re alleged illegal functioning of P.S.B.

Made by D.S. Black Forwarded by D.S.I. Willgoss

Sir,

Enquiries were made at the Ying Ziang Kong Police Station on
the 27/1/34, when it was ascertained that as a result of interro-
gation by the Inspector-in-charge, the man Yui Han Ling (于汉林)
would be charged with complicity in the larceny and handed over
to the Judicial Department of the Public Safety Bureau on the
28/1/34. Copy for A.C. Special Branch forwarded.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,
D.S. Black
D.S. 203

Sen: Let: 1/c/
D.D.O. "B"
Officer i/c .B.

报告

事由（全称） 关于公共安全局涉嫌非法运作的进一步报告

呈报人：副巡官 Black    转呈人：副巡督察 Willgoss

先生：

1934年1月27日，在引翔港巡捕房进行了查询，经查实，经负责巡官讯问后，男子于汉林（Yui Han Ling）将被指控犯有盗窃罪共犯，并于1934年1月28日移交至公共安全局司法科。已 forwarded 副本给助理总监特别支部。

此致，

您顺从的仆人，
D.S. Black
副巡官 203

抄送：信件 1/c/
“B”区副总监
“B”区负责人

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No....4/34.
Yangtzepoo....Station,
REPORT
Date....Jan. 27th,....1934.

Subject (in full)....Alleged illegal functioning of Public Safety Bureau.

Made by....D.S. Black....Forwarded by....D.S.I. Willgoos.

Sir,
At 5.10 p.m. 26/1/34, two Chinese females named Yui Pan Sz (于潘氏) and Yui Mo Sz (于马氏) residing in a straw hut (S.M.C. No. 98) off Ward Road came to the Station and reported that the husband of the former one Yui Han Ling (于海林) had been arrested in the above hut by officers of the P.S.B. attached to Ying Ziang Kong Station at about 2.30 p.m. 26/1/34.
D.S. Black and C.D.C. 135 made enquiries at the Ying Ziang Kong Station and were informed that officers of the Station had arrested a male Chinese Woo Tsau Ling (吴兆林) for larceny. He admitted the crime and stated that the property was kept in the hut of Yui Han Ling. The home of the latter was visited and he requested to go to the Chinese Station for enquiries.
No search of the hut was made, and at the time of detectives visit to Ying Ziang Kong no charge had been preferred against the man who denied the offence. He was still at the Chinese Station at 8 p.m. 26/1/34.
This hut is very near to the Settlement Boundary.
I am, Sir,
copy sent to S.B. H.Q    Your obedient servant,
R.C. Black
D.S. 203

(批：27/1)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项档案号....4/34。
杨树浦....巡捕房，
报告
日期....1934年1月27日....。

事由（全称）....关于公共安全局涉嫌非法运作。

呈报人....副巡官 Black....转呈人....副巡督察 Willgoos。

先生：
1934年1月26日下午5时10分，两名居住在华德路旁草棚（工部局编号 98）的中国妇女，名为于潘氏（Yui Pan Sz）和于马氏（Yui Mo Sz），来到巡捕房报案称，前者之夫于海林（Yui Han Ling）于1934年1月26日下午约2时30分在上述草棚内被隶属于引翔港巡捕房的公共安全局人员逮捕。
副巡官 Black 和华籍侦探长 135 号前往引翔港巡捕房查询，获悉该巡捕房警员因盗窃罪逮捕了一名中国男子吴兆林（Woo Tsau Ling）。该男子承认犯罪，并称赃物藏匿在于汉林的草棚内。随后探访了后者住所，他要求前往华界巡捕房接受查询。
当时并未对该草棚进行搜查，且在侦探前往引翔港巡捕房时，尚未对该男子提出指控，该男子否认犯罪。截至1934年1月26日晚8时，他仍留在华界巡捕房。
该草棚距离租界边界非常近。
此致，
副本已送特别支部总部    您顺从的仆人，
R.C. Black
副巡官 203

（批注：1月27日）
抄送：侦探 1/6
“D”区副总监
（批注：巡督察 / 记录室 / 归档 / [签名]）
